name: claude-code-prod-starter
description: Production-grade Claude Code starter for engineering teams adopting Opus 4.7. Two workflow modes — light (lifecycle commands, no governance) and full (9-gate persona-driven flow). Six PM-style persona agents, three reusable specialist agents (code-reviewer, security-auditor, test-engineer), full SDLC skill library (TDD, debugging, verification, code review, code simplification, context management, model selection, Karpathy guidelines), eight slash commands (/autopilot for full mode + /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /code-simplify, /ship for light), session-start hook with meta-skill auto-injection, and a 5-doc onboarding path. Project-agnostic.
